subject: As DOJ went after protesters for felony assault, juries and judges were unconvinced
posts:
Federal prosecutors claimed aggressive felony charges were necessary to punish violent assaults on law enforcement, but juries rejected every single case brought to trial.
Evidence: Law Enforcement Protection, Mass Case Dismissals, Punitive Deterrence
#Aletheia #USPol

The Justice Department claimed it was impartially prosecuting serious felony assaults against federal officers during demonstrations, insisting charges were backed by evidence.
Stated Judgement: (+0.82, +0.74) — Greater Good

Out of 102 defendants, prosecutors failed to win a single felony trial verdict. 41% of cases were dismissed entirely, 34% reduced to misdemeanors, and all 12 trial cases ended in defeat.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.74, -0.68) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Fall into Destruction. Rushed overcharging transformed political posturing into systemic courtroom collapse.
Integrity: Baseless Lies (Hypocrisy: 129.95, Uncertainty z: 5)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- DOJ Overcharging: FAIL (-0.82, -0.75) — Politically driven charges collapsed in court.
- Judicial Pushback: PASS (+0.78, +0.65) — Juries and judges rejected unevidenced claims.
An AP analysis revealed the DOJ secured zero felony trial wins across 102 protester arrests in four major cities, a stark contrast to the standard 82% federal assault conviction rate.

The Bright Side:
The federal jury system functioned as an effective constitutional check against prosecutorial overreach and politically motivated overcharging.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
WHO vs. WHAT error. The state framed protesters as dangerous felons to justify crackdowns, but physical courtroom evidence proved the charges were unsubstantiated.

Social Physics Analysis:
Prosecutors ran an anti-social extraction loop: manufacturing extreme felony charges as pretexts to project strength, only for transparency in open court to dissolve the narrative.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When aggressive state overcharging collides with jury scrutiny, systemic credibility collapses from assumed authority into courtroom defeat.

The Unavoidable Truth: Juries refused to convict because the government lacked evidence of felony violence.
The Unavoidable Lie: Federal prosecutors claimed every arrestee was a dangerous violent felon.

Alethekanon:
When prosecutors prioritize deterrence over evidence, the courtroom becomes an audit they cannot survive. The 0-for-12 trial record reflects institutional overreach.

Awwthekanon:
It is terrifying to face felony charges and the full weight of the state simply for speaking out. Juries seeing the human reality and choosing fairness brings hope.

Brothekanon:
DOJ went 0 for 12 at trial when they usually win 80%+ of cases. That is not bad luck, that is bringing zero real evidence to court.

Spirithekanon:
"Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent—the Lord detests them both." Proverbs 17:15 FAIL
Weaponizing judicial power to inflict unmerited charges corrupts the foundation of communal justice.
